description_expanded: Escape to Pelican Paradise B, a stunning 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath beachfront sanctuary located in the exclusive gated community of Camp Creek Lake along Scenic Highway 30A. With a private pool, panoramic Gulf views, and direct beach access, this home is the ultimate destination for elevated coastal living and unforgettable group getaways. Beachfront Bliss & Unbeatable Location Directly on the Gulf of Mexico – Wake up to the sound of waves and step onto the sand in seconds. Private Pool – Cool off after beach days in your own secluded oasis. Gated Community – Peaceful, secure, and ideally situated near shopping, dining, and everything 30A has to offer. Option to Book Pelican Paradise A + B – Combine both homes for a 10-bedroom coastal compound—perfect for reunions or retreats. Spacious Interiors with Coastal Elegance Ground Floor Sleeping Quarters – Room 1: Twin-over-full bunk (sleeps 3) Room 2: Two twin bunk beds (sleeps 4) Room 3: King-sized bed (sleeps 2) Wet Bar & Wine Cooler – Easy access to drinks and snacks. Elevated Kitchen & Living Spaces on the Second Floor Chef’s Kitchen – Outfitted with high-end appliances, plenty of prep space, and a wraparound breakfast bar with stools. Dining Area – Beautiful table with seating for six, perfect for family dinners or morning brunches. Living Room – Bright, inviting, and furnished with newly upholstered sofas and chairs. Second-Story Balcony – Grill out, unwind, and take in the breathtaking Gulf views from this private gathering space. Third Floor Master Suite – Gulf Views from Your Pillow King-Sized Master Bedroom – A serene space to retreat at day’s end. Spa-Like Master Bath – Complete with a jetted garden tub and upscale finishes. Private Balcony Overlooking the Gulf – Enjoy sunrise coffee or sunset cocktails just steps from bed. Lounge by the private pool or access the available beach gear set up and head over to the sandy shores for an evening stroll. Swing by The Hub, a central gathering spot in the nearby Watersound community, for great food, drinks, and live entertainment! Hop on the Timpoochee Trail and bike to the nearby communities of Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, or Inlet Beach for a day of fun in the sun! Requests for pool heating must be submitted a week prior to arrival and are subject to an additional $75 fee. Heating for pools is an additional $45 per day. Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund.
